question: Should CodexBar add this permanent local sharing workflow, and should it launch from one existing surface or both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: VISION.md explicitly requires sign-off for new features and cautions against one-off surfaces, so code review cannot determine the intended permanence and placement.

options.title: Approve one entry point
options.body: Keep the local identity-free card and export model but expose it from one existing overview surface to minimize product and maintenance footprint.

options.title: Approve both entry points
options.body: Land both the status-menu action and Settings section after real current-head proof and required checks pass.

options.title: Decline sharing
options.body: Do not add a dedicated export artifact and retain the existing menu, Settings, and CLI usage surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve one entry point
recommendation.body: Keep the local identity-free card and export model but expose it from one existing overview surface to minimize product and maintenance footprint.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available owner for a VISION.md-gated product-surface decision.
